# `return 0` line only for a layout FV_KBD_LAYOUT names that has no default table
# (__FV_KL_ALL=1).
# Layout data: xkeyboard-config 0.1 (symbols/); keysym names: xorgproto 0.1
# (include/X11/keysymdef.h); both MIT/X11-style licences (COPYING of each release).
# Inputs and sha256:
#   (unpacked tree, no sha256) xkeyboard-config-0.1
#   (unpacked tree, no sha256) xorgproto-0.1
# A layout: [CHARACTER]=US-KEY for each non-ASCII character of the main block (TLDE,
# AE01-AE12, AD01-AD12, AC01-AC11, AB01-AB10, BKSL), levels 1 and 2. A default layout:
# its script letters in __FV_KL_D (the default tables), its other characters (symbols,
# Latin letters) in __FV_KL_S, used only when FV_KBD_LAYOUT names it. __FV_KL_NOTAB: the
# symbols files whose own layout has no table (Latin layouts, files that are no layout);
# __FV_KL_VX: the variants with a table among their sections.
